```lean
DivInvMonoid.zpow_succ'.{u} {G : Type u} [self : DivInvMonoid G] (n : ℕ) (a : G) :
  DivInvMonoid.zpow (Int.ofNat n.succ) a = DivInvMonoid.zpow (Int.ofNat n) a * a
```
***
`a ^ (n + 1) = a ^ n * a` 
***
*import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Defs*

```lean
DivInvMonoid.zpow_neg'.{u} {G : Type u} [self : DivInvMonoid G] (n : ℕ) (a : G) :
  DivInvMonoid.zpow (Int.negSucc n) a = (DivInvMonoid.zpow (↑n.succ) a)⁻¹
```
***
`a ^ -(n + 1) = (a ^ (n + 1))⁻¹`
